data.body: FIX IMPLEMENTED + committed (bace2dc4ba): check-staged-head passes draft PRs (the umbrella is always a draft) so its failure no longer contaminates PR1's shared head SHA; ready_for_review added to triggers to close the draft->ready bypass. Enforcement intact (non-draft non-staged still blocks). Behavioral test 5/5. Combined with Fix C (resume fallback excludes base=main umbrella) in 78163b1407, all three 1f5f harms are now addressed. Landing on branch fix/merge-to-main-resume-hardening.
